[color=#99ff99]Hard Light is an english speaking 18+ medium roleplay server[/color]

[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 1: Behavior Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#ff0000]Rules marked in Hardlight's [color=#00fffb]color[/color] will be enforced at all times. Other rules will only be enforced upon recieving a user report.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.1[/color] Don't be a dick, aka, do not intentionally take actions that would negatively impact or disrupt others' enjoyment of the game except when required by your role.
[color=#a4885c]1.2[/color] Avoid controversial topics such as self harm/rape in public.
[color=#a4885c]1.3[/color][color=#00fffb] Don't evade bans in any way, including account sharing or alt accounts. This will be reported to wizden.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.4[/color][color=#00fffb] Taking actions that may harm the server's integrity or stability, such as lag farms, DDoS attacks, or public defamation is forbidden.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.5[/color][color=#00fffb] Impersonation of a position or person is forbidden. Do not pretend to be an admin, do not pretend to be someone you're not out-of-character.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.6[/color][color=#00fffb] If you are frustrated and need a break, you are free to ragequit/disconnect however this will not avoid consequences when you return.[/color]
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 2: Roleplay Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#ff0000]Rules marked in Hardlight's [color=#00fffb]color[/color] will be enforced at all times. Other rules will only be enforced upon recieving a user report.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]2.1[/color][color=#00fffb] Powergaming, defined as taking actions that are impossible or overpowered for your character, is forbidden.[/color]
- [color=#a4885c]2.1.1[/color] Your character should only specialize in at most 2 departments, and one service sidejob. - [color=#a4885c]2.1.2[/color] Metaknowledge, such as knowing the exact damage values or weaknesses of objects, is both metagaming and powergaming. - [color=#a4885c]2.1.3[/color] Do not make antag objectives inaccessible such as tossing them off station. Remember, you need access to them too.
[color=#a4885c]2.2[/color][color=#00fffb] Metagaming, or using out-of-character information for an in-character advantage, is forbidden.[/color]
- [color=#a4885c]2.2.1[/color] Metacommms, or sharing IC information in OOC channels, such as discord, isn't against the rules, but using information learned from it is. - [color=#a4885c]2.2.2[/color] Knowledge gained while unconcious, crit, dead, ghosted, or as another character (or ghost role) should not be known by your character. - [color=#a4885c]2.2.3[/color] If a player is killed and then brought back to life, they cannot recall more than foggy concepts of how they died.
[color=#a4885c]2.3[/color][color=#00fffb] No metagruding. Your character is a separate entity from you, the player, and so are the characters you meet from their players. Your IRL feelings, and the feelings of your character, should not bleed or mix together (aka, bleeding/mixing). In-character rivalries should remain in character, and vice versa.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]2.4[/color] Do not make yourself a major problem, annoyance, or disruption for the crew without a valid reason. Responses should be reasonable and within the realms of what a real person would do in a given situation.
[color=#a4885c]2.5[/color] Do not play excessively hostile, provocative, or generally "unhirable" characters. If you can't pass an interview, you wouldn't be in ColCom space as an employee or contractor.
- [color=#a4885c]2.5.1[/color][color=#00fffb] Roleplaying an underage or child-like character in both mind or body, is strictly forbidden. So is talk of such activities.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]2.6[/color] Respect other people's consent, dignity and boundaries. Check their consent info before engaging in questionable roleplay. If this is abused by either party, ahelp it immediately.
- [color=#a4885c]2.6.1[/color] Consent tags should be reasonable and fair. You can avoid sexual or gorey RP, but you cannot avoid being a victim or target of antag objectives through consent tags. - [color=#a4885c]2.6.2[/color] If someone breaches your consent, they are allowed one warning to back off in case of miscommunication, however any further breaches are grounds for bans. - [color=#a4885c]2.6.3[/color] You are allowed to request an out through any situation via ahelps if you are made uncomfortable, and you will be excluded in the scene through an in-character method manufactured by the admins. The other party will not be notified nor punished in this situation.
[color=#a4885c]2.7[/color][color=#00fffb] If you are banned from a role or department, you may not play that role. This includes seeking or accepting promotions into roles you are banned from or taking Ghost roles which hold the role in question.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]2.8[/color] You are to remain in character at all times. Do not ruin other player's immersion by breaking character, abusing out-of-character chats, or referencing real world events.
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 3: Gameplay Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#ff0000]Rules marked in Hardlight's [color=#00fffb]color[/color] will be enforced at all times. Other rules will only be enforced upon recieving a user report.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]3.1[/color] It is strictly forbidden to livestream rounds to others or share recorded gameplay outside of Hardlight without consent of all parties involved.
[color=#a4885c]3.2[/color] Use the chat channels for their intended purposes. OOC channels should be used sparingly to check global consent. Questions should be asked ICly, conversations should be held on discord.
[color=#a4885c]3.3[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do NOT antag-roll. (Intentionally ghosting or cryoing to look for antag roles.)[/color]
[color=#a4885c]3.4[/color] [color=#00fffb]Ghosting with with the sole intent of spying on others' personal activities is not permitted.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]3.5[/color][color=#00fffb] Making use of cheats, exploits, or bugs to again an advantage is forbidden.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]3.6[/color][color=#00fffb] End-of-round-griefing (EORG) is not allowed under any circumstance. [/color]
- [color=#a4885c]3.6.1[/color] This includes but is not limited to: fighting, explosives, chemicals, destruction of property, or any other disruptive behavior. - [color=#a4885c]3.6.2[/color] All of CC space, arrivals, as well as the Evac shuttle (and evac hallway), are considered Safezones in which this rule takes effect. - [color=#a4885c]3.6.3[/color] If someone is heading to cryo, try not impede them (unless you are security) and let them leave.
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 4: Lore/Setting Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]4.1[/color] Try to be creative by picking a believable and fitting name and/or surname.
- [color=#a4885c]4.1.1[/color] It's suggested to use a lore-accurate name for your race, although exceptions can exist when cultures clash. - [color=#a4885c]4.1.2[/color] Leeway is given to theatrical roles such as the clown, boxer, and mime; these roles are allowed stage names with some amount of freedom. - [color=#a4885c]4.1.3[/color] Being named after a popular figure is ok, but having the same name of a popular figure is not. - [color=#a4885c]4.1.4[/color] Avoid copyright names, such as GlaDOS or Megatron for borgs, Pennywise or The Joker for clowns, and so on.
[color=#a4885c]4.2[/color] You are not not allowed to have supernatural backgrounds, such as; secret demigods, beings from the future, or similar.
- [color=#a4885c]4.2.1[/color] Wizards and those apart of the wizards federation are an exception, however they cannot retain their magical powers while not antag - [color=#a4885c]4.2.2[/color] Changelings, Vampires, Werewolves, and Zombies are creatures of science, not magic. - [color=#a4885c]4.2.3[/color] If you have a strange concept and don't know if its allowed, you are always free to ask using F1 ahelp.
[color=#a4885c]4.3[/color] Don't use hate speech, racism, or bigoted comments. In the 26th century, society has moved passed petty bigotry.
- [color=#a4885c]4.3.1[/color] Distrust of borgs is exempt from this, due to their recent inclusion into sentient life and the existence of hostile rogue borgs. - [color=#a4885c]4.3.2[/color] Your character cannot be sexist, racist, speciest, ableist, lgbtphobic as it wouldn't make sense in an age where all are proven capable and treated equal.
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 5: Erotic-Role-Play (ERP) Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#ff0000]Rules marked in Hardlight's [color=#00fffb]color[/color] will be enforced at all times. Other rules will only be enforced upon recieving a user report.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]5.1[/color] ERP does not take priority over your job. If you are requested or needed, you must respond or return to your duties ASAP.
[color=#a4885c]5.2[/color] Don't use ERP as bait for kill objectives, After the ERP is complete, a grace period of 5 minutes is in effect, during which you are still NOT allowed to kill the target.
[color=#a4885c]5.3[/color] [color=#00fffb]Don't kinkshame.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]5.4[/color] You should use the (-) subtle command for erotic roleplay material, to avoid others from walking in on your scene.
[color=#a4885c]5.5[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do not spam or pollute radio channels (including the telepath channel) with NSFW topics. Mind you, this does NOT mean that you are not allowed to speak or discuss such. There should not be a cringy spamfest of: shitposting, hornyposting, or depression posting.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]5.6[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do not engage in, nor discuss, ‘extreme’ sexual fetishes in public. Public includes: any radio channel (including the telepath channel), out loud speech or overt actions in actual public physical locations, or doing so on camera.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]5.7[/color][color=#00fffb] Engaging in ERP with a non-sentient creature is prohibited. The creature must be player-controlled; consent in OOC, and pass the Harkness test in-character. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]5.8[/color][color=#00fffb] When roleplaying another person's character, OOC consent from the original (the owner of said character) is required before you engage in ERP. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]5.9[/color][color=#00fffb] Be very mindful of in-character and out-of-character consent. If your (out-of-character) OOC consent is not respected, immediately Ahelp or open a ticket. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]5.10[/color] Extreme acts like snuff, abuse, noncon, and other extreme kinks are only allowed if all parties consented OOC, Ahelp if you need clarification (Keep it private).
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 6: Command and Security Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]6.1[/color] Security and Command roles are expected to know and perform their jobs to the best of their ability. You will be held to a higher standard in these roles.
[color=#a4885c]6.2[/color] Both Security and Command are required to Know Space Law, Standard Operating Procedures, Alert Procedure, and Company Policy.
[color=#a4885c]6.3[/color] Don't abuse your position of power.
[color=#a4885c]6.4[/color] You are expected to roleplay with others. This includes antagonists.
[color=#a4885c]6.5[/color] If you're in Command, inform your department and Command before cryoing or disconnecting.
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 7: Antagonist Guidelines[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]7.1[/color] Antagonists are held to a higher standard of roleplay, similar to Command.
[color=#a4885c]7.2[/color] Antagonists are expected to roleplay with others. This includes Security and Command.
[color=#a4885c]7.3[/color] The damage that an antagonist is allowed to cause must be proportional to their objectives.
[color=#a4885c]7.4[/color] Pirates should prioritize theft and ransoming, not murder and destruction.
- [color=#a4885c]7.4.1[/color] Pirates cannot force interactions which result in player or command bank accounts being robbed. (IE: demanding players withdraw funds for ransom)
[color=#a4885c]7.5[/color] Nukies should prioritize destroying the station and command. Non-combatants and freelancers should be ignored, unless they are threatening.
[color=#a4885c]7.6[/color] Revolutionaries want to take control of the station, not destroy it. Converting command should be at least attempted before murdering them.
[color=#a4885c]7.7[/color] Free agents, such as mice, rat-kings, wawas, and so on should only fight in self-defense, unless they are conscripted by a company.
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 8: Escalation Guidelines[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]8.1[/color] Lethal force against players should be a last resort.
[color=#a4885c]8.2[/color] Don't disproportionately escalate in response to others' actions.
[color=#a4885c]8.3[/color] Don't ignore critical or dead players unless related to an objective.
[color=#a4885c]8.4[/color] Don't intentionally round remove other players unless related to an objective.
[color=#a4885c]8.5[/color] Revenge or "getting back" should be reasonable and proportional.
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 9: Ship saving[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.1[/color] [color=#00fffb]Ships are to be no larger than 80x50 tiles.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.2[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do not abuse the ship save mechanic to avoid in-character consequences.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.3[/color] [color=#00fffb]Ship saving backups are only to be used in the event of ship destruction or loss due to a server crash or other unforseen issue. Loading backups otherwise is only to be done with admin permission.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.4[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do not under any circumstances modify a ship save file without admin permission (like with the engine update).[/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.5[/color] [color=#00fffb]DO NOT ADD MORE THAN ONE BLUESPACE STASH PER SHIP.[/color]
